Claimed by OpenAI. Potential Zariski density of integral points on SL_r character varieties of smooth complex curves, after a finite number-field extension. The relative case covers prescribed boundary characteristic polynomials with roots of unity. This is a curve and SL_r subcase with quasi-unipotent boundary data; it does not cover arbitrary groups, higher-dimensional varieties or boundary data.
